references.name: Hattie
references.imagePrompt: Character reference picture for a children's picture book. Hattie: a small round hedgehog about the size of an apple, soft brown spines with lighter tips, a cream-coloured tummy and face, a little pink nose, large friendly dark eyes with a white sparkle, rosy cheeks, short legs and tiny paws; round and soft proportions; expressions range from wide-eyed excitement to a sleepy smile. Shown from head to toe, standing in a neutral, friendly pose, facing slightly to one side, with a calm, kind expression. Plain light background, soft even light, no props, no scenery, no other characters. Soft watercolour picture-book style, bright and warm, rounded shapes, gentle evening light, a peach, lilac and soft blue palette. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks.
